scope: Canonical Indian government and PSU tender/bid document dictionary for goods, services, works, consultancy, GeM, CPPP, and PSU-style tenders.
principles: Tender text remains the source of truth; dictionary entries only normalize names and common evidence expectations.
Do not fail a bidder for a document unless the tender, policy, exemption claim, or bidder structure makes it applicable.
Post-award documents do not block technical evaluation unless the tender asks for a bid-stage undertaking or proof.
Conditional statutory documents should become manual review when applicability depends on site, state, headcount, capacity, sector, or bidder claim.

entries.required_when: Usually universal when the tender provides a bid/proposal form or asks for signed bid submission.
When the tender lists a buyer-specific form, affidavit, undertaking, or annexure that does not map to a more specific canonical key.
manual_review_triggers: generic form key used because no narrower dictionary key matched
